speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; to determine the cause, is your mother's blood type A or O, and is yours A or O? Did she receive Rhogam after a previous pregnancy?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice).

Since the bilirubin level is not yet provided, I will check the lab results to confirm the diagnosis and rule out hemolysis.

REQUEST TEST: Total_Serum_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin, Blood_Type, CBC.

REQUEST IMAGES: None required at this time.
